verses.pali: Aṅguttara Nikāya 5.124
13. Gilānavagga
Dutiyaupaṭṭhākasutta
“Pañcahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato gilānupaṭṭhāko nālaṁ gilānaṁ upaṭṭhātuṁ.
verses.english: “Mendicants, a carer with five qualities is not competent to care for a patient.

verses.pali: Katamehi pañcahi?
Nappaṭibalo hoti bhesajjaṁ saṁvidhātuṁ;
sappāyāsappāyaṁ na jānāti, asappāyaṁ upanāmeti, sappāyaṁ apanāmeti;
verses.english: They don’t know what is suitable and unsuitable, so they supply what is unsuitable and remove what is suitable.

verses.pali: āmisantaro gilānaṁ upaṭṭhāti, no mettacitto;
verses.english: They care for the sick for the sake of material benefits, not out of love.

verses.pali: jegucchī hoti uccāraṁ vā passāvaṁ vā vantaṁ vā kheḷaṁ vā nīharituṁ;
verses.english: They’re disgusted to remove feces, urine, vomit, or spit.

verses.pali: nappaṭibalo hoti gilānaṁ kālena kālaṁ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetuṁ samādapetuṁ samuttejetuṁ sampahaṁsetuṁ.
verses.english: They’re unable to educate, encourage, fire up, and inspire the patient with a Dhamma talk from time to time.

verses.pali: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato gilānupaṭṭhāko nālaṁ gilānaṁ upaṭṭhātuṁ.
verses.english: A carer with these five qualities is not competent to care for a patient.

verses.pali: Pañcahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato gilānupaṭṭhāko alaṁ gilānaṁ upaṭṭhātuṁ.
verses.english: A carer with five qualities is competent to care for a patient.

verses.pali: Katamehi pañcahi?
Paṭibalo hoti bhesajjaṁ saṁvidhātuṁ;
sappāyāsappāyaṁ jānāti, asappāyaṁ apanāmeti, sappāyaṁ upanāmeti;
verses.english: They know what is suitable and unsuitable, so they remove what is unsuitable and supply what is suitable.

verses.pali: mettacitto gilānaṁ upaṭṭhāti, no āmisantaro;
verses.english: They care for the sick out of love, not for the sake of material benefits.

verses.pali: ajegucchī hoti uccāraṁ vā passāvaṁ vā vantaṁ vā kheḷaṁ vā nīharituṁ;
verses.english: They’re not disgusted to remove feces, urine, vomit, or spit.

verses.pali: paṭibalo hoti gilānaṁ kālena kālaṁ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetuṁ samādapetuṁ samuttejetuṁ sampahaṁsetuṁ.
verses.english: They’re able to educate, encourage, fire up, and inspire the patient with a Dhamma talk from time to time.

verses.pali: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato gilānupaṭṭhāko alaṁ gilānaṁ upaṭṭhātun”ti.
verses.english: A carer with these five qualities is competent to care for a patient.”

verses.pali: Catutthaṁ.
